root_cause: Analyzer compared receipt.sha256 instead of receipt.stored_sha256 as the primary stored-copy field.
PowerShell emitted uppercase hexadecimal while Python hexdigest returned lowercase and comparison was case-sensitive.

correct_contract.analyzer_computed_hash: fresh SHA-256 of stored_path, canonical lowercase
correct_contract.comparison: stored copy equals stored_sha256; source_sha256 equals stored_sha256; optional legacy sha256 must also agree
correct_contract.path: receipt-bound stored_path under input/feishu quarantine root only
correct_contract.stability: stat/hash/stat before analysis and revalidation after GPU lock
